note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Every division was filled by a single nomination, so there was no poll; no nomination was received for Glenshesk and the retiring member was re-elected. Filed on the rural districts' polling day, Thursday 5 June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Glenmakeiran' to Glenmakeeran (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Ballycastle Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Glenmakeeran; the rounds were filed as Glenmakeirnan (1924); Glenmakeiran (1930); Glenmakeeran (1933, 1936, 1949); Glenmaccn (1946). This round was filed as 'Glenmakeiran', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (glenmakeiran) answers with a redirect to this one.
